summary: This Form 8-K filed by HCW Biologics Inc. discloses agreements to engage marketing and financial consultants contingent on the closing of an upcoming public offering. The filing does not describe a change-of-control transaction, a shareholder vote, or any departure from normal-course operations. It is an executive compensation/service arrangement. As no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC action, or forced management change is present, this filing is classified as routine and not a special situation.
